_comment: Story recall generation content. wordRanges is what the validator enforces; wordTargets/paragraphHints only steer the model. Thinking tokens count against maxOutputTokens on Gemini 3 — keep headroom for the JSON body.

locale.otherLine: - Write the story and questions in language locale '{locale}'.

lengthInstruction: Length: HARD REQUIREMENT — passage MUST be {lo}-{hi} English words (target ~{target}). Use {paragraphs} paragraphs. Do NOT write a brief vignette or summary; expand with concrete scenes and recallable details until you are inside the range. Count words before returning.
